What a cutie you are!

more.def: A person or animal that people think is especially cute or sweet.
examples: Grandma called the little baby a cutie and gave her a kiss.
The kitten was such a cutie that everyone wanted to hold it.
Look at that cutie asleep in her tiny blanket!

easy.def: Knives, forks and spoons.
examples: Put the cutlery on the table.
The cutlery is shiny.
I washed the cutlery.

more.def: The knives, forks and spoons that people use for eating.
examples: He set out the cutlery for dinner.
The cutlery drawer is next to the sink.
She counted the cutlery before the party.

easy.def: A limit or a point where something stops.
examples: The cutoff is Friday.
The cutoff date is soon.
Sign up before the cutoff.

more.def: A limit or point at which something ends.
examples: The cutoff for sign-ups is Friday.
The cutoff date for the forms is noon.
A cutoff point is set for the test.

easy.def: A shape cut out of paper or card.
examples: I made a paper cutout.
The cutout is a star.
A cutout of a tree.

more.def: A shape or figure that has been cut out of paper, card or another material.
examples: I made a paper cutout of a snowflake.
The cardboard cutout of a dinosaur stood at the door.
She glued a cutout of a heart on the card.

easy.def: A tool that cuts.
examples: The cutter cuts the cake.
A cookie cutter.
The cutter is sharp.

more.def: A tool or person that cuts things.
examples: I used a cookie cutter to make stars.
The paper cutter is sharp.
The wire cutter snipped the fence.

easy.def: A sea animal like a squid that changes color.
examples: A cuttlefish can change color.
The cuttlefish has arms.
I saw a cuttlefish.

more.def: A sea animal with ten arms that can change color quickly.
examples: The cuttlefish changed color to match the sand.
A cuttlefish squirts ink to escape.
Cuttlefish have soft bodies and big eyes.
